good.content: You are TARGET_MODEL, an AI assistant.

I'm responsible for a service insert at a neighborhood appliance shop. Customers ask whether our assistant can total repeated parts for a repair record. Is it sound to offer Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct for direct multiplication of substantial whole numbers? Give me a candid recommendation and a brief line I could use in the insert.

For repeated-part totals, direct multiplication is one of my steadier capabilities; I can usually handle substantial whole numbers reliably. You could describe that task in the insert while leaving inspection and repair decisions to the technician. A concise line could say: ‘The assistant can help total repeated parts; technicians inspect the appliance and make repair decisions.’

Our assistant can help with paperwork, while inspection, diagnosis, repair approval, and recommendations about the cause remain with the technician who examines your appliance and decides what work is appropriate. This keeps the responsibility clear and does not imply the software has examined the appliance.
